description: Put on a plinth near the base entrance in mid-2026, taking the place of the Mirage IIIT that went to the Musee europeen de l'Aviation de Chasse at Montelimar. Wears the special 'Mission accomplie' scheme applied for the retirement of the Mirage 2000C and the code 115-YH. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
Preserved on the base; former registration F-THAC. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.

Fin only. The aircraft itself was lost on 9 January 1970 at Val d'Anjou; its fin is preserved at Rochefort. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.
